home.title: MedicCare
home.lede: One medical data centre where every patient, condition, test and appointment is described by a shared ontology, so the answer to a question is a query the system can show you.
home.howTitle: How a question becomes an answer
home.privacy: Public pages only show reference knowledge and the directory. Patient records require an account and are never listed here.

entry.libraryText: Browse diseases with their symptoms, treatments and medications.
entry.doctorsText: Search the directory by specialty, department or hospital.
entry.hospitalsText: See which department each hospital hosts.
entry.askText: Ask in English or French and read the SPARQL the answer was built from.

home.how1Text: The service detects the language, classifies the intent and links every word to a class, an individual or a value in the ontology.
home.how2Text: A parameterized SPARQL template is filled with the recognised entities: escaped values, enforced limit, role restrictions applied server-side.
home.how3Text: You get the rows, the explanation and the exact query that produced them, so any answer can be checked instead of trusted.

assistant.title: MedTranslate
assistant.publicLede: Python and spaCy analyze the question and link terms to the ontology. RDFLib validates the generated SPARQL, then Apache Jena Fuseki executes it and returns the stored rows. No LLM is used.
assistant.signinBody: Understanding a question is only half of it: the generated SPARQL runs against live records, so the endpoint requires an account and applies the role's data scope before returning a single row.
assistant.stepAskBody: One sentence, in your own language.
assistant.examplesAsk: Which symptoms does diabetes have?;How many appointments are pending?;Doctors working in cardiology
assistant.stepMatchBody: lemmas, synonym dictionary and fuzzy matching against the ontology.
assistant.examplesMatch: List the patients older than 40;Dosage of Metformin;Patients with chronic diseases
assistant.stepQueryBody: a template filled with the linked IRIs, executed on the store.
assistant.examplesQuery: Who is the doctor of Ahmed?;Which hospital hosts the neurology department?;Medications used for hypertension
assistant.samplesEn: Which symptoms does diabetes have?;List the patients older than 40;Doctors working in cardiology;How many appointments are pending?;Medications used for hypertension
assistant.samplesFr: Quels sont les symptômes de la grippe ?;Liste les patients de plus de 40 ans;Quels médecins travaillent en cardiologie ?;Combien de rendez-vous sont en attente ?;Médicaments utilisés pour l'hypertension
